output.reason: The cited line [ev-287398e6dcf6] is only a bare metric name, but it sits in the list introduced by [ev-1f419676f177], which says what the change is. It says metrics prefixed `cortex_` are renamed to start with `loki_` in this release, because the `metrics_namespace` default is `loki`, and that operators who set `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keep the old prefix. That gives the subject (the metric `cortex_ruler_config_updates_total`), the change (renamed to `loki_ruler_config_updates_total`) and who is exposed (setups that do not set `metrics_namespace: cortex`). The consequence is that the old metric name stops being emitted, so anything still querying it (for example dashboards or alerts) gets no data; the excerpt implies this rather than stating it outright.
